chunk_text: one repeated russian word, of the mean chunk length of clean_1024
question: one russian question, repeated as all twenty pairs
statistic: median of the repeats, after one warm-up call
measured_through: rerank.score_pairs, twenty pairs per call: one question's rerank
not_measured: retrieval, model load, and the 5-pair coverage gate, which calls the same function

cuda_contended.competing_work: a comparison arm reranking on the same card, gpu utilisation about 18%

note_contention: the idle number is what the reranker costs; the contended one is what it costs when an interactive answer asks for it on a card a run already owns. An earlier note here said four times, which came from the fp32 model this repo does not run: through the shipped path the same twenty pairs read about twice as slow, and how much depends on what is competing
